_about: ASSEMBLIES goal WP0.2 input: which engineering firm drafted each locally present corpus document, so the dev / held-out split can keep one drafter's documents on one side. Evidence is the PDF's own text layer (title blocks) or sets.json provenance, gathered 2026-09-23 with pymupdf page.get_text(); a firm is named only where that text names it. A document with no identifiable firm is its own group. Two documents are grouped when the text shows a shared firm or a shared design team; that is deliberately conservative (it can only make the held-out side harder, never leak a drafter into it). Byte-identical documents are marked duplicate_of and never counted twice.
